name: Industrious

choices.label: Industrious: which Craft or Profession (alchemy, sailor, ...)

text: **Industrious**: Humans are known in the Inner Sea for their drive and work ethic. Humans with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks and checks with their choice of one Craft or Profession skill. This racial trait replaces skilled.
